scripts.//test:e2e: Deliberately not part of `pnpm test` (§5.3): one browser test, run as its own CI job on one Node version, so the Vitest matrix stays a minute long.
scripts.//shots: Deliberately not part of any test run and never wired to CI (SPEC.md 7.4): it writes pictures for a person to look at, and nothing it writes fails a build.
scripts.//a11y: Deliberately not part of any test run and never wired to CI (SPEC.md 7.12, 5.3): it drives the builder through 60-odd steps in a browser and reports what axe-core finds, for a person to act on. The exported page's check is the gated tier and runs in the End-to-end job. Nothing this reports fails a build.
